summary.headline: Horary Questions on War and Fate
summary.text: Catalog entries 339–360 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering horary questions about failure, events, messages, shipbuilding, stellar configurations, lifespan, ruined cities, possession, war, tyranny, fornication, poisoning, succession, death, runaways, and thieves. Several war-related entries cite Theophilus and cross-reference codex 6; the entry on succession and death invokes Ptolemy’s prior teaching.
